entries.title: Revelation of John 10:1
segments: And I saw another mighty angel coming down out of heaven, clad with a cloud; and a rainbow was upon his head, and his face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.

entries.title: Revelation of John 10:2
segments: In his hand he had a little book, open; and he set his right foot upon the sea, and his left upon the land.

entries.title: Revelation of John 10:3
segments: With a great voice he shouted as a lion roars; and when he shouted, the seven thunders uttered their voices.

entries.title: Revelation of John 10:4
segments: When the seven thunders uttered their voices, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from the sky, saying, "Seal up the words which the seven thunders uttered, and write them not."

entries.title: Revelation of John 10:5
segments: And the angel whom I had seen standing upon the sea and upon the land lifted up his right hand to heaven,

entries.title: Revelation of John 10:6
segments: and swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created the heaven and all that is in it, and the earth and all that is in it, and the sea and all that is in it,

entries.title: Revelation of John 10:7
segments: "Delay there shall be no more, but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to blow his trumpet, then shall there be finished the mystery of God, according to the Good News which he told unto his slaves, the prophets."

entries.title: Revelation of John 10:8
segments: And the voice which I had heard from heaven, I heard again, speaking to me, and saying, "Go, take the little book that is open in the hand of the angel who stands upon the sea and upon the land."

entries.title: Revelation of John 10:9
segments: And I went to the angel and told him to give me the little book. And he said to me: "Take it, and eat it up; it will make your belly bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey."

entries.title: Revelation of John 10:10
segments: I took the little book out of the hand of the angel, and ate it up, and it was in my mouth sweet like honey; but when I had eaten it, my belly was made bitter.

entries.title: Revelation of John 10:11
segments: Then I was told, "You must prophesy again over many peoples and nations and tongues and kings."
